a: For this card's 1st effect, you declare a digivolution, then upon revealing this card, you can also choose a Tamer as the card to digivolve, and that Tamer is also treated as a level 3 Digimon. As with the normal digivolution procedure, after revealing this card and declaring a digivolution, you can't choose to not digivolve.
In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.
Card Q&A.q: Can I choose to not digivolve with this card's 1st effect?

Effect: ＜Material Save 2＞ (When this Digimon is deleted, you may place 2 cards in this Digimon's DigiXros conditions from this Digimon's digivolution cards under 1 of your Tamers.)
[Start of Your Turn] By deleting this Digimon, gain 1 memory.
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 2 cards with [Xros Heart] and/or [Blue Flare] in their traits among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
Special Play Condition: When you would play this card, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each placed card reduces the play cost.
